title: Céline Dion returns to stage for first Paris show: 'I want to sing for you, to sing about life'
subhead: With a controlled voice and a relatively understated show, the Québécois star delighted the 30,000 spectators at the Plenitude Arena just outside the French capital with a 25-song set over two hours and 15 minutes. It was her first concert in six years.

title: 2027 presidential election: Mélenchon pressures left-wing rivals at Fête de L'Humanité festival
subhead: Jean-Luc Mélenchon, presidential candidate of radical-left La France Insoumise, put on a show of strength and engaged in a long-distance dual with Communist leader Fabien Roussel. Mélenchon also sought to convince crowds that he could beat Marine Le Pen.

title: Nour Elassy, Gaza-born poet and refugee in France: 'I live with the guilt of having left my loved ones behind'
subhead: In 2025, the 23-year-old student left her family in the enclave after Israel approved her evacuation, allowing her to attend classes in Paris. She recently published a poetry collection evoking a world engulfed by the destruction of the Palestinian territory.

title: How 9/11 changed the far right
subhead: The September 11 terrorist attacks marked a turning point for radical right-wing movements. Since then, these political currents have adopted a violently anti-Islam rhetoric, positioning themselves as defenders of a so-called 'Judeo-Christian West.'

title: Are influencers out of touch? Their followers are starting to think so
subhead: Like many content creators, French YouTuber Léna Situations has faced harsh criticism that she seems out of touch.
